examples.heading: Tiny tertiary icon
examples.description: A tiny, tertiary, square icon-only button, as the browser frame's address bar renders it. The frame's own svg-size class is left out and the button's tiny svg size ([&_svg]:size-4), which that class replaced in the merge, is restored: tiny keeps its 4px radius, the variant adds no rounded-md.
